intro: The Letter to Delgren is an urgent missive penned by Balthule Shadowstrike near the Tower of Althalaxx in northern Darkshore. Addressed to his mentor, the paladin Delgren the Purifier, it details the sinister operations of the demonic Dark Strand cult. Delivering it carries vital intelligence southward to Maestra's Post in Ashenvale.

p: As cultists of the Dark Strand gather around the ruins of the Tower of Althalaxx, the night elf Balthule Shadowstrike keeps watch over their escalating malice. Lacking the martial might to eradicate the cult alone, Balthule drafts this dispatch to request aid from his tutor in the Holy Light, Delgren the Purifier. Because the cult's foul rites threaten more than just Darkshore's coastline, the message must be carried the entire length of the region into western Ashenvale, where Delgren works in concert with night elf Sentinels to hunt down demonic and undead threats.
